Card Q&A.q: When one of my red or yellow [Marcus Damon] is deleted, can I use this card's [All Turns] effect to place the deleted [Marcus Damon] card from my trash on top of my security stack?

Effect: [When Digivolving] You may play 1 [Marcus Damon] from your hand without paying the cost.
[All Turns][Once Per Turn] When one of your red or yellow Tamers is deleted, place 1 [Marcus Damon] from your trash on top of your security stack face down.
Inherited Effect: [All Turns][Once Per Turn] When one of your red or yellow Tamers is deleted, place 1 [Marcus Damon] from your trash on top of your security stack face down.
